gpt.text: Crix traveled to Utvara by lokopede with Teysa and Melisk, until Aun Yom's band attacked the lokopede and Teysa's uncle was killed.
Trijiro ordered Crix released to improve Gruul relations with other guilds, and Teysa sent Pivlic, Kos and the Grugg Brothers to rescue him.

Kos and the others found Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact, and Teysa read Crix's spell to command the last dragon, until Hauc died in a dogfight and the two dragons killed each other.
